info.title: API Documentation
info.description: This is the OpenAPI specification for Volo Libero Montegrappa.

EventCoverUploadBodySchema.description: Event cover image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB)

key.description: Callsign the track is recorded under

NewsImageUploadBodySchema.description: News image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB)

get.description: Serve one ElMeteo forecast frame as WebP. The source bucket is private, so frames are proxied, converted and cached by the app.

post.description: Upload an event cover image to the public bucket and return its URL

get.description: Tracks recorded in the last 8 hours for every club member with an OGN device, including those out of signal (data from EasyXCScore)
Live OGN positions over the Monte Grappa flying area, with club members flagged (data from EasyXCScore)
Open free-flight SOS alerts raised from the EXTK tracker app (data from EasyXCScore)
Track recorded in the last 8 hours for one OGN callsign (data from EasyXCScore)

parameters.name: key

schema.description: Callsign the track is recorded under

parameters.description: Callsign the track is recorded under

post.description: Upload a news image (cover or body) to the public bucket and return its URL

get.description: Fetch the current XC edition with its tasks, optionally filtered by category
List all XC editions (id, title, active flag) ordered by year desc
Check if the current user is enrolled in the current XC edition

post.description: Enroll the current user in the current XC edition

get.description: Fetch the XC leaderboard for a specific category
Fetch XC progress for a specific category
Fetch all submissions for the current user in a specific category
Fetch XC tasks for a specific category
Get parsed IGC track data (header, stats, fixes) for a submission. Approved tracks are public; pending or rejected ones are readable only by their owner.

delete.description: Delete a submission: removes R2 file, deletes record, recalculates XcProgress

get.description: Fetch XC Task details (includes the current user's submissions when authenticated)
Public XC profile of a pilot: per-category progress for one edition and the approved flights of that edition

post.description: Validate a submission's IGC track against the task's TSK waypoints
Upload an IGC track file for a specific XC task to Cloudflare R2
